t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 8 different types of gnomes, and out of those 8, half of them give you a red basket and the other half give you a different color. It is generally better to stick with the red basket when it is giving a lot of mushrooms, then switch when it starts giving low mushrooms and vice versa.

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 different colored gnomes that each correspond to 2 different colored baskets, a red basket and a yellow basket. The gnomes that lead you to a red basket are: red, pink, brown, and purple. The gnomes that lead you to a yellow basket are: yellow, orange, blue, and green. Once you play a few rounds, this will come naturally to you. The points given by each basket go up and down throughout the rounds independently of each other (they may both be high or both be low, just because one is high doesn't mean the other is low). The points don't change that much round to round, so it's best to try to "ride the wave" of the basket while the points are high, then only change once you can tell the basket's points are falling low. Stick with one colored basket while the points are good (5 and above) and consider switching once the points fall below 4. Use the 1x rounds as an opportunity to check the points of the other colored basket to decide if it's worth switching. In my rounds, I found the red basket to be better overall but this may vary. Try to play safe during 5x rounds (don't switch unless the points are very low, such as 2 mushrooms and below).
